answer: Each agent must lock a bonded stake, payable in walnut or onyx, before it can register; duplicate identities or contradictory signatures trigger slashing of that bond. Since the bond exceeds the profit from one extra wallet, a sybil attacker must lock real capital per identity, not just a trivial fee. Honest agents recover their stake after peers on the knoll attest their record, so the cost of forgery stays high.
